items.title: São Miguel do Oeste (SC) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 8 #PRI 3
items.en_title: São Miguel do Oeste (SC) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 8 #PRI 3
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in São Miguel do Oeste (SC) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 6,190,000; proposals close Dec 8, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
